CheckTitle: Ensure a support role has been created to manage incidents with AWS Support
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that the AWSSupportAccess managed policy is attached to at least one IAM role.
Risk: Without a dedicated support role, incident responders either cannot open AWS support cases or are given overly broad access to do so.

Recommendation.Text: Create an IAM role that trusted users can assume and attach the AWSSupportAccess managed policy to it.
